periods.location: hospital room / televised Seven Stars broadcast
periods.summary: Kanata tells Touka that Yui Tatara is a reflection mage whom even Diamond Dust could not scratch, making her a dangerous opponent for Stella.
periods.cause: Stella turns her delayed B-block match into a four-on-one bout including Akatsuki fighters, prompting Touka and Kanata to evaluate the opponents from the hospital.
periods.process: Kanata recounts her fight with Tatara during the Hagun attack and explains that no attack, not even microscopic Diamond Dust fragments, harmed Tatara. Touka identifies the ability as reflection, a type that returns attacks and grows more dangerous against high-power opponents.
periods.outcome: Stella's friends understand that Tatara is an unusually poor matchup for Stella's attack-heavy style.
periods.aftermath: The warning proves accurate when Complete Reflection shatters Stella's arm, although Stella defeats Tatara by striking through the reflected damage.
periods.significance: Frames Tatara as a counter to Stella and explains why Stella's four-on-one challenge is not merely a show of overwhelming advantage.
